First choose a diagram and <MATH_0001> as in
Lemma <REF_0001>.
We may and do assume <MATH_0002> is affine (this is obvious, but
see proof of the lemma in case of doubt).
By Lemma <REF_0002>
we may assume <MATH_0003> is algebraically closed.
Then <MATH_0004> corresponds to a <MATH_0005>-module.
Such a modules is a direct sum of copies of <MATH_0006>
for varying <MATH_0007> hence we may assume <MATH_0008> is
constant with value <MATH_0009>.
By Lemma <REF_0003>
we may replace <MATH_0010> by the normalization
of <MATH_0011> in <MATH_0012> which finishes the proof.
